findings.title: totalPages off-by-one creates empty last page
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 line 13 totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 users, limit 50) this returns 2 instead of 1, and 100 users with limit 50 returns 3 instead of 2. The correct value is Math.ceil(user_count / limit). Consequence: pagination shows a phantom page, showingLast never becomes true on the real last page, and the next action can set offset equal to user_count which fetches an empty page.

findings.title: group-member itemView uses wrong template context
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs line 1 the template used as itemView for {{each member in members}} references {{member.username}}, {{avatar member}} and {{#unless automatic}}. Inside an Ember itemView the context is already the member User object, so member is undefined and automatic resolves on the User instead of the Group. Consequence: avatar/username render blank, {{action removeMember member}} passes undefined causing member.get(username) to throw, and the remove link is shown even for automatic groups where removal should be hidden.

findings.title: members limit/offset unvalidated allows DoS and 500
findings.body: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb lines 22-23 limit is (params[:limit] || 50).to_i and offset is params[:offset].to_i with no clamping. An attacker can request limit=1000000 to load the entire group into memory in one request, or offset negative which makes ActiveRecord generate OFFSET -5 and raises a 500. Consequence: performance denial of service and unhandled exceptions on public group members endpoint.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace around usernames
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb line 71 usernames.split(",").each passes each token directly to User.find_by_username. A normal input like "bob, alice" leaves a leading space on " alice" which will not match, so the user is silently skipped. Consequence: adding multiple members appears to succeed but only the first is added with no error.

findings.title: remove_member deletes immediately then checks save
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb line 90 group.users.delete(user_id) executes DELETE SQL immediately for a has_many through association, then line 92 calls group.save to decide success. If save fails the deletion is already persisted with no rollback, and if delete is a no-op for a non-member it still returns success. Consequence: misleading success/error responses and no transactional integrity for membership changes.

findings.title: add/remove_member expects group_id but route provides id
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb lines 66 and 85 the actions do Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i), but in config/routes.rb lines 49-50 delete members and put members are defined as bare member routes inside resources :groups, which provide :id like the suspend and other member routes in the same file, not :group_id. Consequence: every real HTTP request raises ActionController::ParameterMissing and add/remove member is completely broken; the controller specs mask it by passing group_id directly and bypassing routing.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined instead of promise
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js line 21 findMembers does return ; when name is empty, whereas before it returned Ember.RSVP.resolve([]). It also no longer returns the members array, resolving to undefined. Consequence: any caller chaining findMembers().then throws TypeError on empty names and existing callers expecting an array break.

findings.title: admin group route no longer waits or handles members errors
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin_group_route.js line 13 setupController just calls model.findMembers() without returning or awaiting it, whereas before afterModel waited and stored members. The same pattern is in discourse/routes/group-members.js.es6. Consequence: first render shows empty member list with wrong pagination, and failures like 403/500 are swallowed instead of transitioning to an error route, leaving an empty table with no feedback.

findings.title: remove_member spec uses wrong HTTP verb
findings.body: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb line 115 the test for cannot remove members from automatic groups does xhr :put, :remove_member while the route is DELETE members. Controller specs bypass routing so the test passes without verifying the real route. Consequence: the group_id vs id routing mismatch and verb mismatch are not caught by tests.
